title: Exit after repeated key combination
line: Pressing the logout or shutdown shortcut again while the logout screen is open now carries out the action right away.
explanation: The logout greeter ignored every prompt request that arrived while it was already showing, so pressing Ctrl+Alt+Del, the power button (default "Show logout screen") or a Shut Down/Restart/Log Out shortcut a second time did nothing, and a countdown kept running. Now, when the same prompt is requested again, the greeter carries out that screen's action immediately: the countdown's action (shut down, restart or log out, installing pending updates when the countdown would) or, for the full logout screen, Shut Down, its default highlighted button (Log Out if shutting down isn't allowed). A request for a different prompt is still ignored.

commits.message:
logout-greeter: Proceed when the same prompt is requested again

Pressing the logout or shutdown shortcut again while the logout screen
was already showing did nothing. Asking for the same prompt a second time
now confirms it right away, instead of waiting for the countdown to end.

BUG: 389896
